style: Rustic medieval European peasant household object, hand-made, weathered and well used, realistic materials, muted earthy colours. A single object on its own with nothing around it.

barrel.prompt: A squat oak storage barrel bound with three dark iron hoops, its lid on.

crate.prompt: A rough plank storage crate of pale pine, nailed together, slightly worn at the corners.

firewood.prompt: A neat stack of split firewood logs, bark on, piled against nothing, roughly a metre long.

bread.prompt: A wooden cutting board with a round crusty loaf of dark bread, a torn piece of bread and a wedge of yellow cheese.

jug.prompt: A glazed brown earthenware jug with a handle and two small wooden cups beside it.

pots.prompt: A small group of three unglazed clay storage pots of different sizes, one with a cloth tied over its mouth.

cauldron.prompt: A black iron cooking pot with a bail handle and three short legs, soot on its sides.

herbs.prompt: Bundles of dried herbs and a braid of garlic hanging from a short wooden rod by twine.

antlers.prompt: A pair of red deer antlers mounted on a small carved oak plaque, to hang on a wall.

pelt.prompt: A tanned brown deer hide stretched flat, fur side out, irregular edges, to hang on a wall.

candle.prompt: A simple black iron candlestick with a half burnt tallow candle and wax drips.

tools.prompt: Farm tools leaning together: a wooden pitchfork, a rake and a scythe with a worn wooden handle.
